plugins.description: Orchestrator agent for end-to-end software delivery: analyst → dotnet-architect → test-designer → developer → dotnet-reviewer, with the development-documentation skill and the .NET / ASP.NET Core / Playwright knowledge bundle.

plugins.name: dgx
plugins.description: Diagram authoring/export bundle (provider-agnostic): typst-diagrams (Typst/fletcher node-edge diagrams with local image embedding) and vsdx-diagrams (JSON diagram spec → native Visio .vsdx via a bundled .NET 10 script — shapes, glued connectors, group enclosures, no Visio required).
